description: Patronus checks user-prompt and tool/MCP-result text before model delivery. PreToolUse checks shell command lines before they run and attributes Patronus operations to this chat; SessionStart validates lifecycle input, reads settings and starts the local scanner in the background; Stop releases the turn's private runtime state. Other tool arguments and media bytes are never scanned.

hooks.statusMessage: Patronus: check shell commands and route receipt operations to this chat
Patronus: check tool and MCP result text before model delivery
Patronus: check prompt text and apply this chat's protection controls
Patronus: read protection settings and start the local scanner
Patronus: release private runtime state at turn end
